🌱 Vegan Emergency Pantry

Shelf-stable items from Costco, with estimated best-by dates.

Costco Pantry List Sam’s Club Pantry List
📅 How dates workEach date shows the typical best-by time from the purchase date. The printed date on each package controls.
🌡️ Store cool, dry, darkHeat shortens shelf life. Put new items at the back. Eat short-life items first.
🧮 How much to keepKeep-on-hand amounts cover 4 people for 14 days.
🥫 Can safety ruleDo not eat food from a can with a bulge, a leak, or deep rust.
